title: Formal bi-entire coefficient majorant for actual Q3 local words
question: Can the actual onsite, Q3-edge and spatial-bond potential differences be controlled by a formal coefficient norm with independent field and source radii, without a finite field cutoff?
method: Define the weighted multivariate coefficient l1 norm ||P||_(R,S) using total field degree and source degree.
Construct the exact actual onsite, Q3-edge and spatial-bond shifted polynomials and verify their coefficient tables.
Compute the one-site rate from one onsite, three Q3 edges and six spatial bonds, then check coefficient-product submultiplicativity and the factorial EGF.
Run independent SymPy and Fraction lanes and compile Lean R223 for the exact rational norm and rate fixtures.
finding: The actual local Q3 shifted polynomials have finite formal bi-entire norms. At R=1/2 and S=1/3, B_on=17/270, B_edge=191/2268, B_bond=7/27, C(R,S)=7073/3780 and tC=7073/18900. Endpoint reversal has equal norm; formal length-n words are bounded by C^n and their factorial EGF by exp(tC).
decision_reason: This is the first checkpoint that removes the pointwise field window at the coefficient-algebra level while retaining all actual local Q3 field terms. It supplies a formal analytic/Frechet candidate but deliberately does not identify its completion with the unbounded Q3 common-core dynamics.

adversarial_review.check: R and S are coefficient-norm radii, not physical field bounds.
The formal l1 norm does not prove q^3 A^(-3/4), CCR domains, or Duhamel convergence.
No representation-independent Banach/Frechet completion or physical observable algebra is inferred.
Absolute coefficient reversal is not an adjoint-history or KMS identity.
The local choice count is bounded-degree; no first-passage or exhaustion estimate follows.
R223 checks exact rational arithmetic only.
No OS/KMS, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A result is claimed.

qft_interface.closed: A formal bi-entire coefficient-level envelope for all declared actual local Q3 potential differences and endpoint orientations.
qft_interface.open: Representation-independent common-core completion, energy/state bridge, actual histories, spatial first-passage, exhaustion, common alpha, KMS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing formal analytic candidate checkpoint. It does not prove Q3 operator dynamics, a thermodynamic QFT, common alpha, KMS, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, Pre-A, TECT production or a Clay result.
